packageRules.description: ruff is pinned in three places that must move in one PR: the ==pin in pyproject.toml's dev extra, uv.lock, and the astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit rev in .pre-commit-config.yaml. CI's lint job runs the pyproject pin and the pre-commit job runs the rev, so a split bump makes the two gates run different linters. Renovate's pre-commit manager is opt-in (enabled above), which is why the rev sat at v0.16.0 while pyproject and uv.lock reached 0.16.10.
